title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
summary_full: Chinese netizens focused on the price of Apple’s iPhone Duo, as cheaper Xiaomi and Huawei foldables raise value comparisons and muddle the foldable's reception.
